question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the world.

HOPE
solution:
The correct answer is "**Despair**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the **given word** and the **correct answer.**
 
• ** Hope(verb): **to want something to happen or be true.(किसी घटना के घटित होने या बात के सच होने की आशा करना).
 
 
• ***Example**:* *I just **hope** the train is on time tomorrow.*
 
 
 
• *​*** Despair(verb): **to lose all hope that something will happen. (आशा छोड़ बैठना)
 
 
• ***Example***: *A few positive words can turn **despair **into hope.*
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the word **Hope** is the most appropriate antonym for **Despair.**
 
• **Therefore, **the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Let's explore the meaning of other options**__:
 
• **Promise**(**verb**): to say definitely that you will do or not do something or that something will happen.
 
• **Trust**(**noun**): the belief that somebody is good, honest, sincere, etc., and will not try to harm or trick you.
 
• ** Faith**(**noun**) : strong belief (in somebody/something); trust.
